_note: The outlets Hollywood News Access pulls headlines and photos from. Celebrity and pop-culture first. Deliberately none of the trade feeds Newswire Hollywood uses (Variety, Deadline, The Wrap, THR, Billboard, Rolling Stone), so the two sites never carry the same wire. A feed that fails is dropped from that run and logged in runbook/wire-feed-status.md; nothing breaks. Wire cards carry the outlet's headline and its own feed photo, credited, linking out. We never republish their text.
